items.title: Drones, protests and new legal powers — what is in the new defence bill?
items.summary: New legal powers aimed at better protecting Australia's defence bases have been quickly pushed through parliament, attracting controversy over a lack of scrutiny.

items.title: Business owner banned from employing migrants
items.summary: An Adelaide restaurant operator has been banned from employing migrant workers until 2029.

items.title: Man accused of child abuse and drug offences in remote community

items.title: Massive illegal fishing bust in northern waters alarms industry
items.summary: Australian Border Force has seized a foreign fishing vessel north of Darwin allegedly carrying more than 25 tonnes of frozen fish.

items.title: Coalition turns against security pact with Vanuatu over net zero clause

items.title: Job losses feared after $20m slashed from Victorian specialist schools
items.summary: Saints College offers young people aged 12 to 25 an alternative to mainstream education, often providing assistance to the state's most vulnerable and marginalised children.

items.title: Driver climbs on car roof after Townsville crash

items.title: Woman bitten by dog in council office demands investigation

items.title: Accused double murderer ‘was not broken down’ by cross-examination, defence says
